description.narrative: Indonesia - Green Prosperity Project - TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE ACTIVITY: Technical assistance will be provided by contractors to the GP Facility Manager, district governments, project sponsors, community groups, and financial institutions in order to prepare low carbon development workplans, consisting of potential projects for funding by the GP Facility or other sources. Technical assistance also will extend to capacity-building necessary for implementation of proposed projects.
